import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.PicEtCrossBaseGraph
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.AbelElement
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0ThetaAssembly

set_option autoImplicit false
universe u
open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
open AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme (CechPic)

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
variable {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]

-- PROBE 1: the counit point and its graph class typecheck at the pushed test.
example (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
    True := by
  let σ := Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))
  let ε := (Over.mapPullbackAdj σ).counit.app C
  let _ : (C ⊗ (Over.map σ).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).left.CechPic :=
    CechPic.map (C ◁ ε).left (abelCechClass C P)
  let _ : (C ⊗ (Over.map σ).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).left.CechPic :=
    Over.graphPicClass C ε
  trivial

-- PROBE 2: the reduction of the A-1 core to a Cech-class identity across the cross-base iso.
example (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
    (h : CechPic.map (crossBaseIso k L C ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom
          (CechPic.map (C ◁ (Over.mapPullbackAdj
            (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).counit.app C).left
              (abelCechClass C P))
        = abelCechClass ((baseChange k L).obj C)
            (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (baseChange k L) ≫ (baseChange k L).map P)) :
    picEtCrossBase k L C ((baseChange k L).obj C)
        (picEtMap C ((Over.mapPullbackAdj
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).counit.app C) (abelPicEt C P))
      = abelPicEt ((baseChange k L).obj C)
          (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (baseChange k L) ≫ (baseChange k L).map P) := by
  rw [abelPicEt, picEtMap_relPicToPicEt, relPicMap_mk, picEtCrossBase_relPicToPicEt, h]
  rfl

end AlgebraicGeometry
